item.title: Retail sales unchanged in December from November, closing out year on a lackluster tone
item.description: By ANNE D’INNOCENZIO NEW YORK (AP) — Shoppers unexpectedly paused their spending in December from November, closing out the holiday shopping season and the year on a lackluster tone. item.title: West Harrison Girls Basketball moves on in Regional tournament with 68-37 win over Ocean Springs!
item.description: The girls kicked off day two of the Class 7A Region Four tournament as the West Harrison Hurricanes take on the Ocean Springs Greyhounds. The Hurricanes won big with a final score of 68-37 to move onto day three where they’ll play Harrison Central. Senior Sydnei Barber was the team’s leading scorer with 24 points. item.title: Gulfport Soccer advances to Round Two of playoffs with thrilling 1-0 win over Brandon!
item.description: The Gulfport Admirals hosted the Brandon Bulldogs for round one of the Class 7A Soccer Playoffs. Junior Gavin Comstock had a goal in the first half and that’s all the Admirals would need to seal the deal. Gulfport beats Brandon 1-0 to advance to round two of the playoffs!
